notes.title: Version 1.1: New Modes - New Rare Items - New Achievements!
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.1[/b] When pressing start you now choose between "Normal", "Normal Marathon", "Hard" and " Hard Marathon". Hard changes various things to make this mode crazy hard while Marathon doubles the amount of objectives needed to complete a level. I've made some changes to make  normal easier, which is why I've added a hard mode(although hard mode is much harder than the old normal). I've also added new Super Items you  can only find in the danger zone and new achievements as well. Also Kellie remodeled the Sewer store! patch notes below!
[list]
[*] 10 new achievements.

[*] New Marathon Mode. Add this to hard or normal mode to double the objectives needed to beat a level. There's an achievement for finishing this 
mode in normal and hard.

[*] New Hard Mode. Various tweaks make this mode very difficult. Some changes are; Sewers lids aren't always around, enemies are sometime 
replaced with harder enemies, no skipping objectives to grind stats(except the Cemetery, good luck with that though), melee and ranged damage are  
doubled and other tweaks. There's a achievement for finishing this mode.

[*] Super Items. Super items are rare powerful items that you have a 40%(increased with the luck stat) chance to find in the Danger Zones. 

[*] New Super Item: Hammer. Infinite armor durability.

[*] New Super Item: Second Chance. When your health reaches 5 you destroy everything in the room and heal to full health and the item is destroyed. 

[*] New Super Item: All Stats Up. All stats are increased.

[*] New Super Item: Golden Crowbar. Gives you 10 crowbars.

[*] New Super Item: Gold Bar. Gives you 99 dollars.

[*] New Item: Wrench. Enemies now have a chance to drop Wrenches that repair your armor for one point.

[*] New Enemies. Three new variations of mini bosses have been added to the carnival for marathon mode.

[*] Kellie gave the sewer store an awesome upgrade.

[*] Change: Picking up health stat up items when the health stat is maxed will still heal you now. 

[*] Change: The amount of time you are Invincible after getting hit has been doubled.

[*] Change: Ranged damage you receive has been turned down in normal mode.

[*] Change: Santa's little helper now only attacks enemies near you instead of destroying everything on the map.

[*] Change: The super Macgyver costume now gives enemies a chance to drop ice cream.

[*] Change: Turned down the amount of cookies and milk the super Santa costume causes to drop.

[*] New Music Track.

[*] Added more tool tips on the street when starting.

[*] Fix: A Sphynx could get stuck in an unreachable spot in one of the Bottomless Pit Danger Zones keeping you from progressing.

[*] Fix: A Loot Goblin spawning in one of the Bottomless Pit Danger Zones kept you from progressing.

[*] Fix: There were a few wonky things going on with saves caused by the last patch.
[/list]

[EDIT]
Version 1.11: Small Fix

[b]Version 1.11[/b] Just a few changes and fixes after more 1.1 testing.
[list] 
[*] Change: I lowered the loot chance for various items in hard mode.
[*] Change: The sniper bullets from the danger zone now do only slightly more damage in hard mode as instead of double.
 [*] Fix: I had an achievement unlocking for the wrong accomplishment.
[*] Fix: There was a crash caused by becoming visible again when wearing the Invisible Man costume if there was a Loot Goblin in the room.
 [/list]

notes.title: Beta 1.5: Leaving Early Access Oct. 11th!! Beta 1.5 Six New Armor Items and New Feedback Flairs!
notes.content:
[b]Beta 1.5[/b] 
Kellie Decided to add some graphics to some of the feedback you get during play, so I added those and they're great! Also she told me how stupid it was that some stat icons are letters and others are symbols and she was right again, so I changed them. We are leaving early access October 11th, next Wednesday, less than a week from now! We will continue to update the game after that, but at a slower pace, maybe. I would like to wait to release bigger patches after release but I struggle to hold new content back, so we'll see how it goes. Thanks for all your help and see you on the new release page Wednesday! Patch notes below!

[list]
[*] New Feedback Flairs: Kellie gave a bunch of the graphical feedback a make over. Things like leveling up, unlocking an upgrade, killing guys with power gloves, ect, now have a cool graphic to go with them.

[*] New stat icons. It didn't make sense that some were letters and others symbols, so they're all symbols now. 

[*] New Armor Item: Bubble Dash. You leave a trail of bubbles when dashing that traps enemies.

[*] New Armor Item: Bullets Can Explode. There's a 20% chance for bullets to explode when hitting an enemy.

[*] New Armor Item: Electric Skipper. It's like the regular Skip-it but also shoots electric bolts.

[*] New Armor Item: More Fire. When creating a fire (Molotovs, Dash Fire, ect..) fires are bigger.

[*]  New Armor Item: Free Armor Repair. You can repair your armor for free when you find a repair bench.

[*] New Armor Item: Psychic Molotovs. Molotovs have longer range and seek out enemies.

[*] Added a notice when using a crowbar that you have one less.

[*] Change: You now need to hold E(or X if using a controller) to use crowbars. This will keep you from opening the sewer on acident when trying to pick something up.

[*] Change: Poison damage caused by the Poison Bullets armor no longer overwrites bullet damage it now stacks causing much more damage.

[*]  Change: Chance to Trap Enemy Bodies armor item has changed to always trap enemy bodies, so it's useful now.
[/list]

[*] Increased chance to win the Lotto and Claw game.

notes.title: Alpha 1.59: Combo Shot Ammo, Chance Power Ups/Downs, Ammo Makeover and Grave Danger!
notes.content:
[b]Alpha 1.59[/b]
Combo Shot ammo is a new fun way to add over 500 more variations to your already randomized weapons! Also there is now a way to lose stat ranks with the new Chance item you'll encounter on your adventures. Do you pick it up and risk losing a stat rank or being struck by lightning? I've added two more Super Ammo types, there had only been one of these in the game so far so this should add some more interesting possibilities. 

Kellie has been continuing her tireless work on the story board and they're looking great! Besides all the stuff in this patch, I've been working the last two weeks on the final area still and the final confrontation. Patches will not be scheduled weekly now that we only have less than two months to release. I may still release a patch weekly, but sometimes I may not if I'm working on something that I can't finish in a week(like adding the story for instance, or the final area). Patch notes below! 

Here's a few more screenshots of "The Bottomless Pit". https://creeksidecreepinvasion.tumblr.com/post/164255945833/alpha-159-combo-shot-ammo-chance-power


[list]
[*] New Feature: Combo Shot Ammo. Combo Shot ammo has a chance to happen every time you reload. If your gun rolls a Combo ammo you will be firing two different ammo types at the same time(it's rad!).

[*] New Power Up: Chance. A Chance power up resembles an animated die, when picked up the results can be positive or negative.

[*] New Rare Super Ammo: Chicken Gun. 

[*] New Rare Super Ammo: Hive Shot.

[*] New Armor Item: Dash Fire. Creates a trail of flames while dashing(This gets crazy when stacked with Eternal Flame and the Dinosaur costumes immunity to fire).

[*] New Armor Item: More Combo Shot. When wearing this armor piece you have a 1/4 chance instead of 1/15 to roll a Combo Shot ammo type when reloading.

[*] Ammo Make Over: I have redone and added new effects for many ammo types; Bowling Balls, Water Balloons, Eggs, Crow Eggs, Toilet Paper, Basket Balls, Tennis Balls, Candy Corn, and Frisbees.

[*] 12 New Cemetery Danger Zones.

[*]Change: Crows spawned from crow eggs now last quite a bit longer, so they have become much more useful(they block bullets if you didn't know).

[*] Fix: I had forgotten to add the objectives(antennas,neighbors,ect) to Danger Zones so you would miss it if you entered one when your objective was supposed to be in the next room. They are in now.
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha 1.58: New Armor Durability Feature + 14 New Armor Items!
notes.content:
[b]Alpha 1.58[/b] Fourteen new armor pieces including some more cursed armor! Big change; armor now loses durability when entering new maps. The default durability is 15, so after 15 maps are completed the armor piece will break if you don't repair it before that point. You can check the durability next to the armor icons on the left of the HUD. To repair your armor you need to find a repair bench and pay $25, this also destroys any cursed armor you may be wearing. I'm not releasing a patch next week because we are now less than two and a half months from release and I need to focus on the final area next week to make sure there are no unforeseen setbacks and then the following week I will have a new patch(not with the final in area yet). Patch notes below!

[list]
[*] New Feature: Armor Durability. Armor now degrades over time and is destroyed if not repaired before durability reaches zero.

[*] New Feature: Armor Repair Bench. You can repair all your armor and destroy all cursed armor for $25 at this shelf.

[*] New Armor Item: Expert Armorer. Armor durability is raised from 15 to 30.

[*] New Armor Item: Slow Loot Goblins. Loot Goblins run at half the speed.

[*] New Armor Item: More Loot Goblins. Loot Goblins are more common.

[*] New Armor Item: No Flies. Mummies don't spawn flies.

[*] New Armor Item: Energy Shield. A shield that protects you from all damage at the cost of durability, when it's durability reaches zero it's destroyed.

[*] New Armor Item: Objectives Repair. Completing your level objectives(like breaking an antenna or rescuing a neighbor) will repair your armor and destroy cursed armor.

[*] New Armor Item: Proximity Barrels. Barrels explode when creeps get near them.

[*] New Armor Item: Barrels of Barrels. More barrels spawn.

[*] New Armor Item: Slower Skels. Skels are slower(skels are the black and white guys that runs at you).

[*] New Armor Item: One Shot Zombies. Zombies, including Zombie Chickens, die(again) in one shot.

[*] New Cursed Armor Item: Contaminated Food. While wearing this armor food hurts you when consumed, and it's green.

[*] New Cursed Armor Item: Mimic Invasion. While wearing this armor there is a greater chance trash cans will be mimics.

[*] New Cursed Armor Item: Firework Duds. You thought you hated Fireworks before? While wearing this armor some of your fireworks don't explode.

[*] New Cursed Armor Item: No Criticals. While wearing this armor you can not make critical hits.

[*] Added a message to inform you when an enemy is killed by a rat or a lighting strike.

[*] Added a tooltip about armor durability.

[*] Added a tooltip about checking equipped armor with B or Tab.

[*] Added a few new sound effects.

[*] Fixed some stuff too boring to mention.
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha 1.57: Ghostly Killer Cars! Delicious Zombie Chickens! Snipers From Hell!
notes.content:
[b]Alpha 1.57[/b] Danger Zones are a new uncommon map type that can sometimes be found on maps with branching paths.

(Here's some screen shots https://creeksidecreepinvasion.tumblr.com/post/163536075668/alpha-157-ghostly-killer-cars-delicious-zombie )  After defeating all the creeps on a map with branching paths a "DANGER!" warning will flash over your head when aproaching one of the danger zones. These maps won't necessary be more difficult than standard maps, but they challenge you in different ways. For instance you may need to cross traffic on a busy highway or you may need to loot a map while avoiding sniper fire. By entering these rooms you will also be given greater rewards like more trash cans, a couple of armor barrels, some mystery boxes, ect. I will be adding more than the twelve maps per area in the future. These are only available in the Downtown and Suburbs areas for now but I'll be adding them to the other areas soon. Patch notes below. More next week!



[list]
[*]New Feature: Danger Zones. Uncommon rooms with a higher risk and reward.

[*] 12 New Danger Zone Downtown Maps.

[*] 12 New Danger Zone Suburban Maps.

[*]New Rare Mini Boss: Super Creep. 

[*]New Rare Enemy: Sniper From Hell.

[*]New Rare Enemy: Ghost Car.

[*]New Rare Enemy: Zombie Chicken.

[*] New Armor Item: Into the Danger Zone. Increases chance of finding a danger zones.

[*] Fix: Fixed a performance issue when completing a level before being ported to the store.

[*] Fix: I broke the Rat King armor in last weeks patch, it's fixed now.
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha 1.56: Major Store Overhaul!
notes.content:
[b]Alpha 1.56[/b]
So we've been working all weekend and into the week on a total store makeover. You now get more options right away and unlock brand new features later on. We have a a new ATM, a Lotto machine and a Claw Game(it's a gambling machine, there's no mini game involved). We also added a spot in the store where you can change out your ammo for $5 each change. Patch notes below. More next week!

[list]
[*]New store overhaul.

[*]ATM: When Unlocked you can deposit up to 99 dollars and withdrawal it when ever you're in the store.

[*]Lotto Machine: When unlocked you can now play the lottery for 5 dollars for a chance to win up to 99 dollars.

[*] Claw Game: When unlocked you can pay 5 dollars for a chance to win armor, costumes and stat items(including double stat items).

[*] Change Ammo: You can now change your ammo type at this shelf for 5 dollars per change.

[*] Clerk Dialogue: The store clerk will now make a comment when you enter the store and move towards him. His comments will change based on the stores upgrade status and other things.
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha 1.54: Peek-A-Boom, Knife Throwing Carnies and New Double Stat Power-Ups!
notes.content:
[b]Alpha 1.54[/b]
We continue our hard work on the final area, but that isn't keeping us from adding some more fun stuff this week! Kellie is around 75% done with the assets for the final area and I have been making new enemies and programming and creating the assets for the final confrontation with dr. Apollyon as well as all the other stuff involved in adding a new area. Patch notes are below. More next week!

[list]
[*] New rare double stat power-up items! Example: Instead of a health up giving you 10 more health a golden power-up will give you 20!

[*] New Armor Item: Peek-A-Boom. While peeking you can call in an air strike to your cursor position once every room(this is a fun one!).

[*] New Armor Item: Bodies Burn. Defeated enemies bodies are set on fire creating a trap for other enemies(stacks with Chance to Trap Enemy Bodies, which give bodies a chance to explode).

[*] New Enemy: You might run into a Knife Throwing Carnie when venturing into the Carnival area.

[*] The Mystery Box is more mysterious now. The mystery box can now contain armor(by far the most common), costumes, stat up power-ups, double stat up power-ups and have a very small chance of spawning a bomb.

[*] 4 New Cemetery Maps.

[*] 8 New Carnival Maps.

[*] Super Sprayer ammo and Water Balloon splash damage now puts out fires(even if you have Eternal Flame equiped).

[*] Lighting caused by the Stormy gloves has a greater chance of striking enemies and it is clearly visible when it does. I had the bolt disappearing too soon when hitting an enemy which made it unclear what was happening.

[*] Slowed down the speed on some enemy projectiles(Super Vampires,Swamp Monsters, Seltzer Spraying Clowns and Pie Throwing Clowns).

[*] Fixed a collision issue with some Carnival tent props that I broke a few patches ago.
[/list]
